sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (13/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (392.0), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and deteriorating credit conditions create severely unfavourable macro backdrop; 57-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) combined with long-term EMA bullish alignment (50/200) and supertrend bullish signal creates a textbook mean-reversion bounce setup in a fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all key moving averages (9, 20, 50 EMAs), momentum is uniformly negative (MACD, AO, CMF), no bullish crossovers have triggered, macro environment is in crisis (VIX 392, credit spreads elevated), and fundamental conviction is absent—oversold bounce lacks confluence and occurs in hostile regime.
